--- backend env example ---
# ── Server ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
LOG_LEVEL=info
LOG_LEVEL_HTTP=info
NODE_ENV=production
ENVIRONMENT=<development, testing, production>
NETWORK_INTERFACE=0.0.0.0
PORT=4000
# Port for the worker process' /api/v1/health probe (worker only, no public API).
WORKER_PORT=4001
# Number of reverse proxies in front of the API (0 = exposed directly). Express
# derives req.ip from the last N X-Forwarded-For entries, and the auth rate
# limiters bucket on that: too low lumps every client into one bucket, too high
# lets clients spoof the header and evade the limit.
TRUST_PROXY=0
CORE_BACKEND_DOMAIN=<your_core_backend_domain>
FRONTEND_DOMAIN=<your_frontend_domain>
SEND_SERVER_ERROR_MESSAGE=<true, false>
SECRETS_ENCRYPTION_KEY=<your_secrets_encryption_key_min_32_chars>

# ── Database ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
DB_HOST=localhost
DB_PORT=5432
DB_USER=<your_db_user>
DB_PASS=<your_db_password>
DB_NAME=<your_db_name>
DB_POOL_SIZE=10
DB_DEBUG_SLOW_DB_ACCESS=0
DB_MAX_DEADLOCKS=100
DB_SSL=false

# ── Email ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
SMTP_ENABLED=<true, false>
SMTP_HOST=<your_smtp_host>
SMTP_PORT=465
SMTP_USERNAME=<your_smtp_username>
SMTP_PASSWORD=<your_smtp_password>
SMTP_FROM_EMAIL=<defaults_to_smtp_username>
SMTP_FROM_NAME=DAZ Pilot

# ── Auth ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
SUPER_ADMIN_API_KEY=<your_super_admin_api_key_min_64_chars>
# Requests per client IP per 15 minutes across all /auth routes. Note that every
# device behind one NAT gateway (a whole school) shares a bucket when TRUST_PROXY
# cannot separate them.
AUTH_RATE_LIMIT_MAX=60

# Python sidecar (embed, dedup, train, classify).
ML_SERVICE_URL=http://localhost:8000
ML_SERVICE_TIMEOUT_MS=120000
ML_EMBED_CHUNK_SIZE=24

# Upload storage and ffmpeg input for the ingest worker.
MEDIA_STORAGE_DIR=./media
MEDIA_PUBLIC_PATH=/media
MEDIA_URL_SIGNING_KEY=<your_media_url_signing_key>

# JSON/urlencoded body limit (not multipart). Video/image uploads use API schema limits.
# Scan requests: max 15 MB raw image as base64 data URL (~20 MB encoded).
HTTP_BODY_LIMIT=22mb

# Training video frame extraction. ffmpeg samples at FPS × CANDIDATES Hz;
# the sharpest frame is kept from each candidate group.
FRAME_EXTRACTION_FPS=5
FRAME_EXTRACTION_CANDIDATES_PER_FRAME=3

# OIDC App URL Prefix
OIDC_APP_URL=https://api.daz-pilot.sh/auth/oidc
UPLOAD_KEY_FINGERPRINT=<your_upload_key_fingerprint>
PLAY_APP_SIGNING_FINGERPRINT=<your_play_app_signing_fingerprint>
APPLE_APP_TEAM_ID=<your_apple_app_team_id>
--- dashboard env example ---
# Dashboard env vars for the native dev server (npm run dev).
# Copy to dashboard/.env:  cp dashboard/.env.example dashboard/.env
#
# next.config.ts validates both against envSchema and exits on a miss.
# In the Docker stack these come from docker-compose.yml instead.

# Backend URL the dashboard server calls (server components, route handlers).
CORE_BACKEND_DOMAIN=http://localhost:4000
# Same URL, inlined into the client bundle (Next.js Image remotePatterns).
NEXT_PUBLIC_CORE_BACKEND_DOMAIN=http://localhost:4000

# Optional. On-premises single-school installs: skip the school-slug screen and
# go straight to this school's login. Leave unset for multi-school hosting.
SCHOOL_SLUG=school
